items.titleEn: Data shows Bruno Guimarães deal could be another Arsenal set-piece masterstroke
items.summaryEn: Brazilian excels at winning free-kicks and conjuring results from them, hence why the champions were willing to spend £75mBruno Guimarães has broken a very niche record. His £75m move to Arsenal is the most expensive transfer for a midfielder aged at least 28. This should not be taken too seriously given the previous record holder, Zinedine Zidane, moved 25 years ago from Juventus to Real Madrid, and would have cost far more in 2026 money. But it shows how highly the Gunners rate the Brazilian to have spent so much on a player who will be in his 30s before the end of next year. It is a transfer for today, not tomorrow.The question is why. One reason is that Guimarães rarely misses matches. Another is that he can play anywhere across midfield in the 4-3-3 formation Mikel Arteta often deploys. items.titleZh: 数据显示吉马良斯交易或成阿森纳定位球又一妙招
items.summaryZh: 吉马良斯7500万镑转会阿森纳，创28岁以上中场转会费纪录，他擅长利用任意球改变比赛。
bodyZh: 巴西人擅长赢得任意球并从中创造机会，因此这家冠军俱乐部愿意花费7500万英镑。布鲁诺·吉马良斯打破了一项非常小众的纪录。他以7500万英镑转会阿森纳，成为28岁以上中场球员中身价最高的转会。鉴于之前的纪录保持者齐内丁·齐达内25年前从尤文图斯转会皇家马德里时，以2026年的货币价值计算会贵得多，因此这一纪录不必太当真。但这表明枪手对这位巴西人的评价有多高，竟愿意为一位明年年底前就将年过三十的球员花费如此巨资。这是一笔为当下而非为未来的转会。问题在于为什么。原因之一是吉马良斯很少缺席比赛。另一个原因是，他可以在米克尔·阿尔特塔经常使用的4-3-3阵型中胜任中场任何位置。在德克兰·赖斯正应对腿筋长期神经痛的情况下，这些特质可能价值连城。

items.titleEn: Bruno Guimarães completes £75m Arsenal move: ‘I needed a new challenge’
items.summaryEn: Four-year deal signed after Newcastle’s reluctant sale‘I want to win trophies and I’m in the right place to do it’Bruno Guimarães says he “needed a new challenge in my life” after joining Arsenal from Newcastle for £75m and has targeted winning trophies. Guimarães is understood to have signed a four-year contract that contains a further one-year option after Newcastle reluctantly agreed to sell their captain.The 28-year-old, who captained Newcastle to their first trophy since 1955 when they won the Carabao Cup last year, had made it clear that he wanted to join the Premier League champions after meeting the club’s new manager, Matthias Jaissle, this week. items.titleZh: 布鲁诺·吉马良斯7500万英镑转会阿森纳：‘我需要新的挑战’
items.summaryZh: 布鲁诺·吉马良斯以七千五百万英镑从纽卡斯尔加盟阿森纳，签下四年合同，称需要新挑战并渴望赢得奖杯。
bodyZh: 纽卡斯尔不情愿出售后，签下四年合同 ‘我想要赢得奖杯，我正处在合适的地方’ 布鲁诺·吉马良斯表示，在以七千五百万英镑从纽卡斯尔加盟阿森纳后，他“在生活中需要新的挑战”，并瞄准了赢得奖杯。据了解，在纽卡斯尔勉强同意出售队长后，吉马良斯签下了一份四年合同，其中包含一年的续约选项。这位28岁的球员，去年作为队长带领纽卡斯尔赢得卡拉宝杯，那是该队自1955年以来的首个奖杯，他在本周会见了俱乐部新主帅马蒂亚斯·雅伊斯勒后，明确表示他想要加盟这支英超冠军球队。继续阅读……

items.titleEn: Jay-Z’s Roc Nation Sports making waves in European football transfer market
items.summaryEn: Vinícius Júnior and Yan Diomande are among more than 100 players at an agency owned by the hip-hop legendIn the end there was a clear winner. And Jay-Z’s latest victory came only 24 hours after the first record featuring him actually rapping for four years had been released by his wife, Beyoncé, on an extended remix pack of Morning Dew (Donk).These days, the man who remains one of the most influential artists in hip-hop has his fingers in many pies, from the streaming service Tidal and his own streetwear brand, to champagne and cognac. But it is Roc Nation Sports – an offshoot of his entertainment company of the same name founded in 2008 – making headlines in the summer transfer window. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: Jay-Z的Roc Nation Sports在欧洲足球转会市场掀起波澜
items.summaryZh: Jay-Z旗下经纪公司Roc Nation Sports在夏窗引发关注，旗下拥有超100名球员。
bodyZh: 维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔和扬·迪奥曼德是这家嘻哈传奇人物拥有的经纪公司旗下超过100名球员中的两位。最终有一个明确的赢家。而Jay-Z的最新胜利，距离他妻子碧昂丝发布他在四年来首次真正说唱的单曲《Morning Dew (Donk)》的扩展混音包仅24小时。如今，这位仍是嘻哈界最具影响力艺术家之一的人物涉足众多领域，从流媒体服务Tidal、自有街头服饰品牌，到香槟和干邑。但正是Roc Nation Sports——他在2008年创立的同名娱乐公司的子公司——在夏季转会窗口成为头条新闻。继续阅读...
